occurrences.text: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
